interface.title: Protein Sequence Analyzer (Version 2, Streamlit)
interface.stage_of_work: Early characterization of a protein from its sequence alone, before expression, purification or assay design
interface.what_it_is_for: Paste one protein sequence (FASTA or raw) and get its physicochemical properties, amino acid composition, a rough secondary-structure and hydrophobicity profile, extinction coefficients, a plain-language reading, and exports as CSV/Excel/JSON/PDF.

data.note: The app has no file-upload widget, only a paste box, and the browser cannot read the test files' contents. So I typed equivalent sequences: hen egg-white lysozyme (UniProt P00698, 129 aa, with a FASTA header) in place of lysozyme.fasta, an 8-residue peptide in place of short_peptide.fasta, a sequence containing digits, '*' and X/Z/B/J/O/U in place of invalid_chars.fasta, and a 65-nt DNA string in place of dna_sequence.txt. I also added human ubiquitin (76 aa, raw, no header, no Cys) as a second protein. The lysozyme results match published values (14.31 kDa, pI 9.32, ε280 37470/37970), so the typed sequence is the real protein.

features.name: Sequence paste box with validation messages and record parsing
features.general: Paste a biological sequence, run a check, and get either a go-ahead with the record's ID and parsed header details or a specific reason it was refused (empty, too short, wrong alphabet, wrong molecule type)
features.specific: 'Paste Protein Sequence (FASTA or Raw Sequence)' text area + Analyze Protein button. FASTA header is parsed into 'Sequence Loaded: <ID>' and shown in the FASTA Information table and Sequence Preview on Basic Analysis. A short sequence gives a yellow warning but still runs. Invalid letters are listed next to the valid 20-letter alphabet. A DNA string is detected and refused. Newly typed text is only taken after Ctrl+Enter or a second Analyze Protein click (replay finding).
steps: Paste a FASTA record or a raw sequence
Press Ctrl+Enter in the box, then press Analyze Protein (or click it twice)
Read the banner: ID loaded / valid, or the warning/error
Fix the input from the listed bad characters and run it again
On a valid record, check the FASTA Information table and Sequence Preview
serves_tasks: Load a well-formed sequence record with its identifier
Load a bare sequence with no header
Check the parsed record details and a preview of the sequence
Find out why an input is rejected or flagged

features.name: Metric-card dashboard with normalized radar profile
features.general: Show a handful of headline numbers for one item as large cards, and draw the same numbers scaled 0–1 on a radar so the item's overall profile can be read at a glance
features.specific: Protein Dashboard cards (Sequence Length, Molecular Weight, Isoelectric Point, Stability, GRAVY, Aromaticity, Helix, Instability) and the Protein Property Radar Chart over pI/MW/Length/Instability/Aromaticity/GRAVY, with a fullscreen view. One sequence is shown at a time; there is no side-by-side comparison
steps: Analyze a sequence
Read the metric cards on Basic Analysis
Scroll to the radar chart to see the normalized profile
Open the chart fullscreen
serves_tasks: Get summary physicochemical properties of the protein

features.name: Composition table with paired frequency and ranked-percentage charts
features.general: Count each category in a sequence, list counts and percentages in a table, and plot them both in fixed order and ranked largest-first
features.specific: Amino Acid Composition table (Code, Amino Acid, Count, Percentage) + 'Amino Acid Frequency' vertical bars (alphabetical) + 'Amino Acid Composition (%)' horizontal bars sorted descending
steps: Open the Amino Acid Composition tab
Read counts and percentages in the table
Scan the alphabetical frequency chart
Use the ranked percentage chart to see the most abundant residues
serves_tasks: Determine the amino-acid (residue) composition of the protein

features.name: Framework chrome (not this tool's component): Streamlit dataframe toolbar (sort, search, column visibility, fullscreen)
features.general: Sort a results table by any column, search for text in it with match highlighting and a hit count, hide columns, and expand it to full screen
features.specific: Built-in Streamlit st.dataframe toolbar, present on every results table (composition, FASTA info, extinction, Download Analysis) because of the framework, not written by this tool: click a header to toggle ascending/descending, 🔍 search ('acid' → 2 results), 👁 Show/hide columns with checkboxes (index, Code, Amino Acid, Count, Percentage), ⛶ fullscreen
steps: Click the Count header once for ascending, again for descending
Open search and type a term; matching cells are highlighted with a result count
Open Show/hide columns and untick a column
Open fullscreen to view all rows, then exit
serves_tasks: Determine the amino-acid (residue) composition of the protein
Export the full set of results in a chosen file format

features.name: Two-condition comparison bar with rule-based interpretation
features.general: Compute a quantity under two conditions, show both side by side in a table and a bar chart, and print a one-line reading of whether the difference matters
features.specific: Extinction Coefficient table and 'Protein UV Absorbance (280 nm)' chart for Reduced vs Oxidized. If they differ: 'Disulfide bond formation may influence UV absorbance'. If equal: 'likely contains no disulfide bonds'.
steps: Analyze a sequence
Read the reduced and oxidized coefficients in the table
Compare the two bars
Read the interpretation line; repeat with a protein without Cys to see the other message
serves_tasks: Estimate light-absorbance coefficients and whether disulfide bonds are possible

features.name: Fraction breakdown with predominant-class callout
features.general: Split an item into a few classes that add to a whole, plot the fractions, and name the dominant class or give a practical reading
features.specific: Secondary Structure Prediction (Alpha Helix / Beta Turn / Beta Sheet %) with 'predominantly Beta Turn', and Hydrophobic vs Hydrophilic % with 'predominantly hydrophilic and likely to be soluble'
steps: Open the Structural Analysis tab
Read the fractions table
Read the bar chart with percentage labels
Read the callout naming the dominant class or what it implies
serves_tasks: Estimate secondary-structure fractions of the protein
Judge likely solubility from the share of hydrophobic vs hydrophilic residues

features.name: Threshold-based plain-language interpretation panels
features.general: Turn computed numbers into short statements using fixed rules (e.g. stable if instability index < 40, soluble if mostly hydrophilic, dominant structure class, possible disulfides if two coefficients differ) and close with an overall assessment
features.specific: Interpretation tab panels: Protein Stability, Hydrophobicity, Secondary Structure, Extinction Coefficient, Overall Assessment
steps: Open the Interpretation tab
Read the stability statement and the threshold it uses
Read the hydrophobicity, secondary-structure and extinction-coefficient statements
Read the Overall Assessment
serves_tasks: Read a plain-language summary of the results

features.name: Multi-format results export with preview table
features.general: Preview the table of results that will be exported and save it as CSV, Excel, JSON or a PDF report
features.specific: 📥 Download Analysis table preview + Download CSV / Excel / JSON / PDF Report buttons at the bottom of the Interpretation tab. Each download reruns the app and clears the results. The replay confirmed only CSV
steps: Scroll to Download Analysis on the Interpretation tab
Check the preview table
Press a download button
Press Analyze Protein again before downloading a further format, because a download clears the results
